notes.title: 1.1 update with fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/a26cffb2927c29418c690f246759687b9cfe83e9.png[/img]

Hello wizards and demons and please welcome our 2019 1.1 update. 

- Optimization! We have fixed the problem for those who experienced problems with black screen upon the game launch. You should not experience this issue any more. If you still have this issue please take a look on this topic - https://steamcommunity.com/app/765470/discussions/1/3317353727668663102/

- Now it is visible how many gold you have in city building screen

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/307f5d172df51cc40e1bc14762a1526f4b95e55b.png[/img]

- In city building screen now you can visually see which building or area you can build next

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/4c07eb8fff4b6bc7803abf2de14dcfb6239ca2e7.png[/img]

- The price for action is visible in pop up windows

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/8feef04776b973ceca6278aec4d1504546c026b5.png[/img]

- Missioners of the Wizard increase morale faster (by 1.5) 

- Warriors of the Demon decrease morale faster (by 1.5) 

- Many other small fixes

We wish you pleasant global fantasy domination! Check Fast Guide to learn the game play quicker - https://onedrive.live.com/?authkey=%21AOupX3F6TH_9-pI&cid=FC96AE7C1813B0C8&id=FC96AE7C1813B0C8%21722&parId=root&o=OneUp


Check another game from Alina Digital for global domination in the world of Cold War

https://store.steampowered.com/app/583590/Arms_Race__TCWE/

notes.title: Update 6: Rewind News, Music, Sounds and more
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

It was a huge delay since the time of the last update, but we’ve done a lot during this month:

- First of all we’ve added a new UI window with buttons to rewind news. So now you can easily switch between current and the last 9 previous news (all together 10 news). In game this window looks like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/709d8527c4530a86adeef30d3ad9177fd8344d9e.jpg[/img]

- Then we added fantasy styled beautiful music and sounds to the game - so you can fully immerse into the game atmosphere!

- We also tested game for bugs and get rid of if not all but the most of them!

- Also fixed game balance - so now playing as good or evil character feels completely different!

- Got rid of some small mistakes in different text descriptions and updated the game manual.

That’s all for now. Most part of the game is done and we start making all necessary preparations for the game release.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 5: Game Manual
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Game manual with a detailed description of game mechanics and user interface is finally ready. We tried to make it as simple for understanding and structured as possible. Hope you like manual and it will help you better understand the basics and fully immerse into the game.

Here is the example of the title page:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/48bb4799cd2c91c9f88a209bb98b3c7380977f4d.jpg[/img]

Do you like it? Please, say your opinion in the comments below!

We also plan to make in-game tooltips for easier understanding of gameplay: functions of different buttons and icons.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 4: Playable build
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Sorry for the delay, but it worth it!

Playable game build is ready and we’re testing it for bugs and making some necessary corrections. 
All that left is visual effects, music and sounds and game manual, but the most part of the work is done!

Here are some screenshots to show you the work in progress:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/394440d7c573afeb19e9898d1192df89d1c2fdd7.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/f429757f2025f80e0efad47942f291e429a0f240.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383139/96ccb10821ab19ed9f45f946c29574409f010c51.jpg[/img]

Game still misses some visual details, such as fog on the corners of the main game screen with map view and some icons in building screen, and we also have to fix game balance, but all the game mechanics are working properly and the game is running well overall.

Hope you like the game when it’s finished!

Stay tuned!
